description.value: Tomato's is an Indian restaurant in Surrey's Newton neighbourhood serving a broad menu spanning tandoori appetizers, Indo-Chinese dishes, biryanis, and a dedicated vegetarian section. The restaurant offers dine-in with table reservations as well as takeaway and delivery within a 15 km radius. Menu filters for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, and nut-free options make it accessible to riders with a range of dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website at tomatossurrey.ca is live and fully functional, confirming the business is open and operating. The address and phone are drawn from the website (7238 137 St, Surrey, BC; 604-502-0206) since OSM carries neither field. The website's address places this restaurant in Surrey (Newton area), not Tsawwassen as the OSM community tag suggests, which is flagged as a concern. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site; takeout and vegetarian/vegan/GF options are confirmed directly from website content.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Tsawwassen' but the website address (7238 137 St, Surrey, BC V3W 1V3) places the restaurant in Surrey's Newton neighbourhood — the community tag appears incorrect and may cause misrouting in the directory.
OSM record carries no address or phone; both were sourced entirely from the website and could not be cross-checked against OSM values.
URL discovery confidence is 'high' but the domain name (tomatossurrey.ca) references Surrey while the OSM node is tagged to Tsawwassen — worth verifying this is not a different branch location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Indian restaurant with a live website, online ordering, and table bookings. Straightforward inclusion as a Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' category; order filters explicitly list Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten Free, Dairy Free, and Nut Free options
